source.method: Built-in imagegen 4 diagonal columns x 10 complete pose rows; helper chroma-key alpha; largest body component only; grayscale neutral base; deterministic attached contact shadows; fire frames use complete no-fragment aim/firing stance; stronger panel mask; deterministic POT packing.

runtime_tint_contract.base_draw: neutral white/gray body_shadow_pot for all soldiers; no baked faction colors
runtime_tint_contract.mask_draw: optional technical faction_mask_pot is packaged with identical rect/pivot/transform/UV if Gameplay later receives PM/user approval for mask tinting
runtime_tint_contract.do_not_tint: Do not tint the whole body atlas; do not bind colored preview art.
runtime_tint_contract.note: Latest user direction: do not present all colors; deliver one neutral white/gray soldier atlas. Colored blue/red preview sheets are intentionally excluded from this V30 handoff.
